block.title: Plate with four through holes and a top pocket

manifest.title: Plate with four through holes and a top pocket
assumptions: The pocket is centered on the plate at (30,20) in XY, so it spans x=20..40 and y=15..25.
Pocket and hole edges are sharp, with no fillets or chamfers.
The pocket does not intersect any hole.
The pocket is cut from the top face (z=5), so its floor is at z=2.

limitations: Circular diameter check establishes an edge diameter, not hole depth or placement.
Unlisted requirements and manufacturing suitability are not verified.

brief.title: Plate with four through holes and a top pocket
assumptions: The pocket is centered on the plate at (30,20) in XY, so it spans x=20..40 and y=15..25.
Pocket and hole edges are sharp, with no fillets or chamfers.
The pocket does not intersect any hole.
The pocket is cut from the top face (z=5), so its floor is at z=2.
requirements: One plate spanning x=0..60, y=0..40, z=0..5 mm (unchanged).
Four 4 mm diameter through holes centered at (10,10), (50,10), (10,30) and (50,30) mm (unchanged).
One centered 20 x 10 mm rectangular pocket, cut from the top face, now 3 mm deep (floor at z=2), with sharp corners. This is the only change.
Checked: exterior bounds, solid count, total volume and circular diameter 4 mm.
Unchecked directly: hole count, hole positions, pocket position, and the pocket depth and floor height. Pocket depth is only indirectly constrained by the volume check.
